name: QoL Bundle
description: A client-side bundle of 39 independent quality-of-life modules, each with its own switch and settings (press K or use Mod Menu). The grey-zone modules (AFK Clicker, Freecam, Elytra One-Key Take-off, Water & Lava Vision, Rear-view Mirror) are off by default and meant for single-player and your own server.
